Asha (support): Heads-up — customer claire@acme.co reports promo 'SPRINGLAUNCH23' rejected via API with 'invalid or expired'. Dashboard shows quota remaining (1). CX ticket #2345. Can someone triage? @Marta

Marta (billing): Thanks @Asha. Can you paste the API response + request payload and the time the user tried? Also did they paste code in checkout or via account settings?

Asha (support): They pasted at checkout. Reprobed with curl just now:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \n  -d '{"code":"SPRINGLAUNCH23","email":"claire@acme.co"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
{"error":{"code":"promo_deactivated","message":"This code has been deactivated","meta":{"reason":"partner_migration_cleanup","deactivated_at":"2026-03-16T22:41:02Z"}}}
```

Marta (billing): 410 seems odd. Promo should 400 or 404. @Sebastian can you check if the promo record was soft-deleted or flagged during migration?

Sebastian (eng): I'm looking. Querying internal DB now. Saw a migration job on 2026-03-16 that flipped state -> 'deactivated' for partner promos older than 2024-12-31. This particular code was flagged because partner_id null mismatch. It should not have been deactivated — looks like a join bug. I'll attach the admin request to re-enable.

Sebastian (eng): Temporary mitigation: we can run admin API to re-activate single code for the account:
```
POST https://admin.redwood.ai/internal/promos/SPRINGLAUNCH23/reactivate
Body: {"reason":"support_repro","note":"manual re-enable for claire@acme.co"}
```
Sebastian (eng): I'm pushing a fix to skip codes that still have remaining redemptions >0. ETA ~2h. For now Marta, please issue the manual credit and I can re-enable the code.

Marta (billing): Will do. Issuing one-time credit $50 to claire@acme.co and marking ticket. @promo-bot can you confirm code state after reactivation?

promo-bot: audit-log: promo SPRINGLAUNCH23 state_change: deactivated -> active by Sebastian at 1715000600 (note: manual re-enable).

Asha (support): Thanks all. Ticket updated with repro steps + manual credit. @Sebastian please post follow-up when migration fix deployed.

Sebastian (eng): Will confirm here when fixed and close the loop. thx :raised_hands:
